pages.lesson:
LESSON: HOME HYGIENE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Hygiene Practices
Topic 3.2: Home Hygiene

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Home Hygiene. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Home Hygiene
2. Practise Home Hygiene at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Home Hygiene

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Home Hygiene
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Home Hygiene. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Home Hygiene at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Home Hygiene at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Home Hygiene
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Home Hygiene. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Home Hygiene using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Home Hygiene in the examples.
2. Explain Home Hygiene to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Home Hygiene.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Home Hygiene using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Home Hygiene important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Home Hygiene
2. Practise Home Hygiene at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Home Hygiene

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
